trap.label: avaliação unidade 9
trap.wrong: Can you tell me what time is it? He is afraid to fail. The apps who help me are free.
trap.right: Can you tell me what time it is? He is afraid of failing. The apps that help me are free.
trap.why: Itens da avaliação: ordem afirmativa na pergunta indireta, adjetivo + preposição + -ing e who para pessoas, that para coisas. O português não faz essas distinções.

mcq.q: Do you know what time ___ right now?
The apps ___ help me are free.
The place ___ we met is closed.

fix.wrong: She is good at to draw.
The woman which called is my aunt.
fix.right: The woman who called is my aunt.

rewrite.prompt: Torne indireta: “What time is it?” (Can you tell me...)
rewrite.answer: Can you tell me what time it is?

rewrite.prompt: Una com that: “The app is free. It helps me.”
rewrite.answer: The app that helps me is free.
